blocks.text: European leaders have so far found compromises in response to many of US President Donald Trump’s demands. But they were surprised to hear Trump say that he raised Europe’s security framework with Russian officials. “It’s going to be a big agreement and it’s going to involve more than Ukraine,” Trump said after meeting Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev at the White House last week. He said that deal might include all of Europe. But what he meant by “all of Europe” was not clear.
